mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{id} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT m.data_type AS "dataType", m.required_yn AS "requiredYn", m.teacher_editable_yn AS "teacherEditableYn" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y'

INSERT INTO education_achievements ( achievement_type, teacher_user_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_name, achievement_detail, attachment_ref, created_by, updated_by, request_id ) VALUES ( 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT', #{r.teacherUserId}, #{r.organizationCode}, #{r.evaluationYear}, #{r.managementItemCode}, #{r.achievementDate}, #{r.achievementName}, #{r.achievementDetail}, #{r.attachmentRef}, #{r.actor}, #{r.actor}, #{r.requestId} ) RETURNING achievement_id
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{r.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{r.achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{r.achievementName}, achievement_detail = #{r.achievementDetail}, attachment_ref = #{r.attachmentRef}, updated_by = #{r.actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{r.requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{r.achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED') AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.status, j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId", j.diagnostic_message AS "diagnosticMessage" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{id}

SELECT i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.achievement_id AS "achievementId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{id} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id

SELECT t.template_id AS "templateId", t.template_version AS "templateVersion" FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.required_column FROM excel_upload_template_rules r WHERE r.template_id = #{id} ORDER BY r.column_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status) VALUES (#{id} || '-' || #{number}, #{id}, #{number}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{status})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors ( error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide ) VALUES (#{id} || '-error-' || #{number}, #{id}, #{number}, 'row', 'INVALID_ROW', #{reason}, '양식을 확인하세요.')
mapper.select: SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", f.error_file_token AS "errorFileToken" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{id} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' FOR UPDATE OF f
SELECT s.row_payload::text FROM excel_upload_staging_rows s WHERE s.upload_id = #{id} AND s.validation_status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY s.row_number
SELECT e.row_number AS "rowNumber", e.column_name AS "columnName", e.error_reason AS "errorReason" FROM excel_upload_errors e WHERE e.upload_id = #{id} ORDER BY e.row_number

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.original_file_name AS "fileName", f.uploaded_at AS "uploadedAt", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", h.total_count AS "totalCount", h.success_count AS "successCount", h.error_count AS "errorCount", h.saved_count AS "savedCount" FROM excel_upload_files f JOIN excel_upload_histories h ON h.upload_id = f.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{id} ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.upload_id
